parameters.description: Exact-match filter after normalization for the parent list's item_type. Accepts 1 through 512 Unicode characters, following the same normalization as item creation. Commas are literal. Values are trimmed and compared exactly after item-type normalization for deduplication and membership. card_fingerprint is the 32-character hexadecimal value from PaymentMethod.fingerprint and is lowercased; case_sensitive_string preserves case and Unicode composition. string and email are lowercased, with accents preserved. email requires a bare address. email_domain is lowercased, has one final dot removed, and converts internationalized domains to ASCII. ip_address uses canonical IP form, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 conversion to IPv4. country uses uppercase ISO codes. card_bin preserves 6 through 8 digits, including leading zeros, and matches the full value. customer_id preserves the validated ID.
